所有经验、轨迹与注入记账都会被删除，无法恢复。: Every lesson, trace and injection record is deleted. This cannot be undone.
打开后，AI 在工作区执行每条命令前都会先弹窗问你；也可以在弹窗里打开「本次会话: When on, the AI asks before running each command in the workspace; you can allow the rest of the chat from that dialog. Off by default. MCP tool calls, calendar and reminder writes, and system commands each have their own approval and are unaffected.
把发声切换为系统语音吗？: Switch the voice to the system one?
播放、倍速与声音调节已统一收纳在此处。: Playback, speed and voice all live here now.
改的是名字本身，整个 App 都会跟着换。: This renames the assistant itself — the whole app follows.
暂无挂载的定时任务或脉搏: No scheduled tasks or pulses yet
替换为 (留空表示删除匹配内容): Replace with (leave empty to delete the match)
未启用的项将自动采用底层供应商或全局默认参数。: Anything left off falls back to the provider's or the global default.
未找到该任务或任务已结束: That task wasn't found or has already ended.
本次会话不再询问这类操作: Don't ask again for this kind of action in this chat
点击右上角「+」可为该人设添加常用提问或预设对话轮次。: Tap + in the top right to add common questions or preset turns for this persona.
点击右上角「+」可添加清洗思考标签、特定角色前缀或格式修正规则。: Tap + in the top right to add a rule that strips thinking tags, role prefixes or fixes formatting.
点击进入人设微调主页，左滑可复制或删除人设。: Tap to open the persona's settings. Swipe left to duplicate or delete it.
画面是什么，图上有什么字: What's in the image, and any text on it
竖图最好，底部对齐铺满。不传就用头像放大。: A portrait image works best, bottom-aligned and filling the width. Without one the avatar is scaled up.
系统语音当前被静音。允许后它会参与朗读与 AI 语音回复；随时可在本页关闭。: The system voice is muted. Allow it and it joins reading aloud and spoken replies; you can turn it off on this page anytime.
约10字，如：委屈抱枕头: About 10 characters, e.g. hugging a pillow, feeling wronged
终端与文件操作默认以此目录为根路径。: Terminal and file operations start from this directory.
维护只删过期 / 超限的轨迹与注入记账（经验条目永不物理删除）；清空会抹掉全部进: Maintenance only clears expired or over-limit traces and injection records — lessons themselves are never physically deleted. Clear wipes every piece of evolution data and cannot be undone.
聊天中展示助手名字: Show the assistant's name in chats
聊天中展示助手头像: Show the assistant's avatar in chats
规则按顺序应用于生成的内容，对所有角色生效。可用于清洗思考标签、特定角色前缀或格: Rules run in order on generated text, for every persona. Use them to strip thinking tags, role prefixes or fix formatting.
记录只存脱敏后的轨迹（工具名 / 耗时 / 成败 / 参数摘要），原始内容不落库: Only sanitised traces are stored (tool name, duration, success, argument summary) — raw content never hits the database. Turning this off only stops collection; existing lessons keep being used.
该人设跨会话持久保存的核心记忆与背景知识。: Core memory and background this persona keeps across every chat.
输入给模型的客户端指令/调整要求…: Instructions or adjustments for the model…
还没有服务，去下面添加。: No services yet — add one below.
还没有注入记账。开「影子」用一会儿，这里会记下每次「本来会参考」的条目。: No injection records yet. Run in shadow mode for a while and every entry it would have used shows up here.
还没有轨迹。用一会儿，任务收尾后这里就有账了。: No traces yet. Use it for a while and they'll appear once a task wraps up.
这些任务在应用内运行：到点由 Minis 自己触发。应用不在时不会执行——下次打: These tasks run inside the app — Minis fires them when they come due. Nothing runs while the app is closed; on next launch they re-arm and any fires missed in between are recorded.
这就是 SOUL.md 的正文，决定它说话的性格和身份。: This is the body of SOUL.md — it decides how the assistant talks and who it is.
这是内置人设，删不掉。提示词可以改，但改了之后它的 MCP 管家身份可能会变味。: This is a built-in persona and can't be deleted. You can edit the prompt, but changing it may dilute its MCP-steward role.
这条消息未保存到本地数据库: This message was not saved to the local database
选择系统或第三方语音服务: Pick the system voice or a third-party service
速度基准：最终播放速度 = 此处 Speed × 语音设置里的播放倍速。: Final playback speed = this Speed × the playback rate in Voice Settings.
隐身生效：反馈作为独立系统指令注入模型上下文，不在你的气泡中发出；AI 下轮静默: Silent: your feedback is injected as a separate system instruction, never posted as your message. The AI acts on it next turn.
预设短语可在输入栏中快速调用，或作为该人设发起会话时的示例范例。: Preset phrases are quick to insert from the input bar, or act as examples when this persona starts a chat.
默认「影子」：只记录、不使用——攒够对比数据、你审过之后，再考虑开「启用」。: Shadow is the default: record only, never use. Build up comparison data, review it, then consider turning it on.
